tools.description: Lists resource templates provided by MCP servers. Parameterized resource templates allow servers to share data that takes parameters and provides context to language models, such as files, database schemas, or application-specific information. Prefer resource templates over web search when possible.
tools.name: list_mcp_resource_templates

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous list_mcp_resource_templates call; omit for the first page.

server.description: MCP server name. Omit to list resource templates from every configured server.

tools.description: Lists resources provided by MCP servers. Resources allow servers to share data that provides context to language models, such as files, database schemas, or application-specific information. Prefer resources over web search when possible.
tools.name: list_mcp_resources

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous list_mcp_resources call; omit for the first page.

server.description: MCP server name. Omit to list resources from every configured server.

tools.description: Run a bounded local check under the tool owner's sandbox.
tools.name: exec

tools.description: Read one approved public or scratch file.
tools.name: read_file

tools.description: Write one explicitly approved output or scratch file.
tools.name: write_file

tools.description: Read a specific resource from an MCP server given the server name and resource URI.
tools.name: read_mcp_resource

server.description: MCP server name exactly as configured. Must match the 'server' field returned by list_mcp_resources.

uri.description: Resource URI to read. Must be one of the URIs returned by list_mcp_resources.
